brief: Trump's mail-in voting contradiction and North Korea overtures dominate US politics, while a new open-source AI model matches GPT-5 performance, and research spans from brain tumor segmentation to cotton fiber analysis.
news_summary: Trump votes by mail despite criticism, threatens Middle East mediators, and reportedly reduces US-South Korea drills citing Kim Jong-un relations. Australia finalizes gambling reform, and extreme weather hits South Korea and the Philippines.
